name: Secure SVG
author: Utility Plugins

sections.description:
Secure SVG allows you to safely upload SVG files to your WordPress media library while ensuring they are properly sanitized to prevent security vulnerabilities.

Features:

  • Automatic SVG sanitization
  • Removes potentially malicious content
  • Preserves valid SVG markup
  • Compatible with WordPress media library
  • Simple to use – just install and activate

Privacy Policy

Secure SVG does not collect or store any personal data.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the secure-svg folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Upload SVG files as you would any other media file
sections.faq:
Is it safe to upload SVG files?

Yes, when using this plugin. It automatically sanitizes SVG files to remove potentially harmful content while preserving the valid SVG markup.

What WordPress versions are supported?

The plugin is tested and compatible with WordPress 5.0 and above.
